== Mage Training Arena and Teleport Unlocks ==

{{Checklist|title=Section 17|
* Minigame tele to Mage Training Arena, bank upstairs
* Bank, withdraw Nature Runes, Water Runes, Staff of Earth, and 6 Food
** Get 211 Graveyard Points
* Bank, withdraw Law Runes and an Air Staff
** Get 1150 Telekinetic Points total
* Bank, withdraw Nature Runes and a Fire Staff
** Get 1150 Alchemist Points total
* Bank, withdraw Cosmic Runes and an Earth Staff
** Get 9500 Enchantment Points total
* Buy Bones to Peaches
* Bank, withdraw Water Staff, Earth Runes, Nature Runes
** Get 739 Graveyard Points total
* Buy Rune Pouch, Infinity Boots, and Master Wand from the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Rewards_Guardian_(Mage_Training_Arena) Rewards Guardian]
* Train Construction to 50 (If you aren't there already)
{{Youtube|GFH6-oJrJ0o}}
* Bank, withdraw Earth Runes, Water Runes, Law Runes, Soul Runes, Air Runes, Hammer, Saw, 12 Teak Planks, 6 Limestone Bricks
* Teleport to house, make a [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Portal_chamber#Portals Portal Chamber room, 3 Teak Portal Frames, and 1 Teleport Focus]
* Direct the Focus
** Draynor Manor Teleport
** Salve Graveyard Teleport
** Frankenstrain's Castle
** Use these in the future when questing
